description: Standing approval block for scheduled internal governed mutation. Replaces the per-call HyperAgent plan+approval flow for cron-driven callers while preserving auditable lifecycle (granted/expires/review/policy).

approval_token_digest.description: sha256 of the standing approval token (no plaintext)

granted_at.description: ISO datetime when the approval was granted

expires_at.description: ISO datetime — MUST be set; null forbidden for standing approvals

policy_bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the active policy bundle this approval is bound to
